headline: Massive goodwill writedown swings quarter to a steep loss
summary_short: Conagra's fiscal Q4 2026 revenue was $2,882M (+3.6% y/y, +3.4% q/q), but a $1.61B goodwill impairment plus $350.2M of brand-intangible writedowns in Refrigerated & Frozen drove a $1,617M net loss versus $256M net income a year earlier.
summary_long: Revenue rose 3.6% y/y to $2,882M and gross profit improved 7.1% q/q to $704M, but GAAP results were swamped by non-cash impairments: Conagra recognized a $1.61B goodwill impairment and $350.2M of indefinite-lived brand intangible impairments (Birds Eye, Armour, Bertolli, Angie's BOOMCHICKAPOP, Wish-Bone) in its Refrigerated & Frozen and Grocery & Snacks reporting units, driven by a 200bp discount-rate increase, weaker market multiples, and downward revisions to the unit's sales and margin outlook. That swung EBIT to -$1,588M and net income to -$1,617M from positive prior-year figures. Subsequent to fiscal year-end, the board cut the quarterly dividend to $0.175/share from $0.35/share. Fiscal 2026 capex totaled $423.4M; asset sales (Chef Boyardee, frozen fish) generated $648.9M.

drivers.explanation: Result driven almost entirely by non-cash impairments recognized in the fourth quarter of fiscal 2026 in the Refrigerated & Frozen reporting unit, following similar (smaller) impairments in the second quarter of fiscal 2026.

Fiscal-year commentary (10-K gives no isolated Q4 narrative) cites an extra 53rd week and Foodservice organic price/mix gains, partly offset by organic volume declines in Grocery & Snacks, Refrigerated & Frozen, and International.

not explained in the release for this specific quarter — the 10-K's segment gross-profit commentary covers full fiscal year 2026 only (input cost inflation and unfavorable operating leverage cited at the annual level).

Q4 FY2026 goodwill impairment of $1.61B in Refrigerated & Frozen plus $350.2M of brand intangible impairments (Birds Eye, Armour, Bertolli, Angie's BOOMCHICKAPOP, Wish-Bone), driven by a 200bp discount-rate increase, weaker market multiples, and downward sales/margin revisions for that unit.

Fully explained by the same Q4 goodwill and intangible impairment charges (~$1.96B combined) recorded below gross profit; operating-income-level performance (ex-impairment) was actually up q/q and only modestly down y/y.
